description: Imaris-direct and TIFF-based volume preparation: stream .ims channels to Zarr, build the registration NIfTI from an ims pyramid level (no TIFF layer), plus legacy TIFF preprocessing/downsample tools.

rules: Whole-brain production runs must avoid TIFF intermediates. Source data is Imaris .ims (hundreds of GB per file): stream it with ims_to_zarr instead of exporting TIFF folders.

Preprocessing/enhancement (channel_subtraction, median_filter, clahe, tophat, rolling_ball, scattering_removal, surface_brightness_homogenize, edge_signal_removal) is DISABLED by default in production configs: every preprocessing.*.apply=false. Thresholds then operate on raw stored intensities and stay comparable across samples and batches. Only enable a step for a diagnosed, sample-specific artifact.

main.py is TIFF-folder-native but skips steps whose outputs already exist: pre-create ch<signal>.zarr (ims_to_zarr), ch<reg>_downsample/volume.nii.gz (zarr_to_registration_nii) and sample_dir/original_shape.json (full-res z,y,x of the signal grid) to run it with zero TIFF folders.

For the registration channel only a coarse pyramid level is needed: read it with ims_to_zarr --resolution_level N (level N is 2^N x downsampled, level 2 ~ 8x) and rescale to 25 um with zarr_to_registration_nii; delete the coarse zarr afterwards.

Deliverables are Zarr/Excel/PNG: keep segmentation.export_mask_tiff=false and registration.save_upsampled_label=false (the label TIFF is written only as a transient intermediate and removed after zarr conversion).
Entry points marked "legacy_tiff": true below are kept for old samples that only exist as TIFF folders; do not use them for new Imaris-based production runs.

entrypoints.description: PRIMARY entry point: stream selected channels of an Imaris .ims directly into Zarr (per-channel gzip zarr, dataset '0'). Select coarse pyramid levels with --resolution_level N (Imaris levels are 2^N per axis) when full resolution is not needed. Resumable; the reference driver _run_YF2025063002_vessel.py step 1 shows usage.
prerequisites: Imaris .ims file must exist and be readable (DataSet/ResolutionLevel N/TimePoint 0/Channel M/Data)
Output .zarr must not exist (or resume an incomplete one)

output.description: Output .zarr path (single channel) or directory root (multi channel)

resolution_level.description: Imaris ResolutionLevel to read; 0 = full resolution

chunk_size.description: z,y,x; z sets the streaming read slab

entrypoints.description: Rescale a (coarse pyramid level) Zarr to the registration spacing and write volume.nii.gz with the same NIfTI convention as preprocessing.downsample (xyz transpose + diagonal affine), so ANTs_registration consumes it in place of the TIFF-folder downsample. Also writes original_shape.json (full-res z,y,x + spacing) beside the output; copy it to sample_dir/original_shape.json for ANTs label upsampling. Tested in tests/test_zarr_to_registration_nii.py.
prerequisites: Input Zarr with dataset '0' (commonly an ims pyramid level written by convert_ims_to_zarr)

input_resolution_xyz.description: x,y,z um of the input zarr (native ims resolution x 2^level)

entrypoints.description: Apply optional channel subtraction plus ordered enhancement steps to one or more TIFF channels and emit per-channel manifests. Legacy TIFF path; production configs keep every step disabled (see production_policy).
prerequisites: Requested channel TIFF directories must exist and contain TIFF slices

channel.description: Optional channel override such as '1' or 'ch1'

output_dir.description: Optional custom root for chX_preprocessed outputs

config_path.description: Optional config.json path used when caching adaptive weights

entrypoints.description: Convert a TIFF stack directory into a directory-store Zarr volume with basic multiscales metadata. Legacy TIFF path; prefer convert_ims_to_zarr for Imaris sources. Used internally by registration for the atlas label zarr.
prerequisites: Input TIFF directory must exist and contain TIFF slices

input_dir.description: Single-channel TIFF folder; required unless using sample_dir + channels batch mode

output_zarr.description: Single-channel output .zarr; required unless using sample_dir + channels batch mode

sample_dir.description: Sample root for batch conversion of ch0,ch1,...

channels.description: Comma-separated channel labels for batch mode

workers.description: Thread count for parallel TIFF chunk reads; 0 auto-uses min(8, cpu_count // 4), capped at 2 when read batch matches z-chunk

read_z_chunk.description: Slices per read batch; 0 matches the Zarr z-chunk for fastest conversion

skip_existing.description: In batch mode, skip channels whose chX.zarr already exists

entrypoints.description: Downsample a 3D TIFF stack into a new TIFF stack plus NIfTI volume, using nearest-neighbour interpolation. Legacy TIFF path; prefer zarr_to_registration_nii on an ims pyramid level.
prerequisites: Input TIFF directory must exist and contain TIFF slices or a single OME-TIFF

entrypoints.description: Equalize regional inner/outer tissue brightness with a log-domain shading field, keeping local highlight structure. Viewing-oriented; not wired into main.py.
prerequisites: Signal TIFF directory must exist and contain TIFF slices

tissue_mask.description: Optional manual/SAM tissue mask Zarr or TIFF; skips automatic hysteresis when set

target_scale.description: Multiply shell I_ref; values below 1 press the surface darker

ref_mix.description: Shell I_ref mix in log space between observed surface and interior

output_zarr.description: OME-Zarr group with dataset 0 plus 2x pyramid levels 1..N. Open with napari-ome-zarr for 3D.

qc_zarr.description: Sibling *_qc.zarr with a single dataset 0 of shape (3, z, y, x): input, tissue mask, normalized downsample

entrypoints.description: Add 2x OME-NGFF pyramid levels (1, 2, ...) to an existing 3D Zarr group that already has dataset 0. Needed for napari 3D viewing via napari-ome-zarr.
prerequisites: Input must be a Zarr group containing a 3D array named 0

method.description: mean for intensity; nearest for integer labels

scale_zyx.description: Full-res voxel size Z,Y,X written into NGFF scale

zarr_path.description: Same store, now with extra resolution arrays and NGFF multiscales metadata

entrypoints.description: Suppress bright sheet-like edge noise in signal TIFF stacks using a warped atlas label mask. Wired into main.py when preprocessing.edge_signal_removal.apply=true (requires registration label).
prerequisites: Signal TIFF directory and warped atlas label TIFF directory must exist with matching slice counts
Usually runs after registration produces sample_dir/upsampled_atlas_label/

label_dir.description: Warped atlas label TIFF folder, commonly sample_dir/upsampled_atlas_label/

output_dir.description: Cleaned TIFF folder or downstream Zarr input

entrypoints.description: Nearest-neighbour upsample a downsampled mask Zarr back to full-resolution shape guided by a full-resolution signal Zarr.

Parallel subtract a background channel from a target channel in TIFF stacks for autofluorescence removal. Also available through run_preprocessing when preprocessing.channel_subtraction is configured.

subtracted_tiff_dir.description: Per-channel subtracted TIFF output folders under the sample root
